Specifies whether to use an SSL-secured connection (tcps URI
scheme).
Values: false/0/no or true/1/yes
Default: false

For protocols and transports that accept multiple message types on
a given transport, specifies the message type to use.

Custom connection URI parameters to be passed in the URI query
string.
For example:
tcp_nodelay=true&tcp_sndbuf=8192

Allows a custom URI scheme to be specified.
When both secure and urischeme are specified, urischeme takes
precedence.
